lines.welcome: Welcome to the light table. Every block on this paper is a part of the code.
lines.lift-wing: Pinch a wing, and pull it toward you.
lines.lift-room: Now pinch the glowing room, and pull it up.
lines.step-in: Pull it once more, to step inside.
lines.ask: Hold a feature, to ask me about it.
lines.decide: Each screen on the deck is one decision. Tap approve, or decline.
lines.step-out: Push away, to step back out.
lines.hand-off: That's the morning round. The table is yours.
